notes.title: Another small update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

this small update contains these changes:
 The berry chaser sequence at the end a little bit shorter.
 I've raised the default multiplier in the Driving School slightly so people less inclined to do "stunts and backflips" won't be stuck there forever.
 Ignoring the Deity and skipping school also adds to the rudeness now.
 Finally I've deleted the L'animateur achievement, it just is counter-intuitive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542669/0397c5d666dbd5064ecc50e19bb7e4a67de334e1.png

The picture in this change log is by Lintire. 

That's it and thank you for the attention!

PS:
The Deity wants you to stop calling him Yoda, that's very rude!

notes.title: First update for Deity Driving!
notes.notes:
Hi there,
a playthrough by Soshiki Hakase helped me find some more bugs that I didn't see before!

[previewyoutube=9afHihevPic;full]][/previewyoutube]

Now fixed: Not being enter to able the garage under certain circumstances
 The driving school music not playing
 Fixed being able to use god hand in driving school too early
 Updated the credits sequence
 The Squatter achievement is now easier to get, driving school isn't mandatory at all!
 Fixed being able to spam Duckman's 2nd rap several times
Thanks for everyone who has played it or spread the word!

Have a nice Sunday,

Vinzenz
